candidates.title: Map resume details into application forms

demandEvidence.chore: The poster spends two hours every day entering resume data into forms tailored to one or two companies.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I spent two hours every day filling my resume data to freshly developed forms made specifically to the hiring process of one or two companies.

ease.reason: A beginner could prototype form-field mapping from a supplied resume and sample form, but no implementation reference is attached.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: job seekers might pay for less repetitive application entry; the discussion establishes no purchase intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map a resume to a few manually supplied fields; company-specific forms and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed tool can prepare field values, but a person must check each form and submit it; no automation capability is documented.

evidence.reason: The fresh post states a daily two-hour resume-entry chore for forms tailored to one or two companies, but gives no field details or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: assess a narrow draft of resume facts for repeated application fields; no supplied source supports live form integration or buyer willingness to pay.
